10. CW-1 was examined as PW-1.
She in her examination-in- chief has deposed that her marriage with accused No.1 was performed on 14-02-2013.

PW-1 further deposed that on 09-12- 2012 her parents and her relatives went to the house of accused situated at Hyderabad, at that time accused have demanded 250 gms of gold, 500 gms of silver items and cash of Rs.50,000/- when
5  C.C.No.22051/2019 they expressed their inability, accused have obtained 180 gms.
Of gold and 500 gms.
Of silver and cash of Rs.50,000/- as dowry from them.
PW-1 further deposed that herself and accused No.1 went for honeymoon to Darjeeling from Hyderabad and stayed in a hotel.
The accused No.1 insisted her to consume liquor and forcing her to act as in porn videos , when CW-1 refused to do so, accused abused and asked her to refund the expenses met in honeymoon tour.

PW-1 in her further examination in chief deposed that after the marriage, accused looked after her well and deposed accused did not subjected her to any physical and mental cruelty, in demand of dowry and never abused her.
PW-1 deposed that there was petty quarrel between her and accused in respect to family issues, for which she went to the police station.
There the police have took her signatures on documents.
PW-1 identified Ex.P.1 first information statement and also identified her signature at Ex.P1.
PW-1 also identified Ex.P.2 spot Panchanama and her signature at Ex.P2 and she pleaded her ignorance about the contents of Ex.P.1 and P.2.

sentences.text: During which PW-1 admitted that she and accused have compromised the matter and denied all other suggestions.
On appreciation of entire materials on record, it is apparent that PW-1 being the informant, key and material witness have turned hostile to the prosecution case.
She has given 2 different narations of events during her recording of evidence.
First time she gives incriminating evidence against the accused on the other date she turns hostile to the case of the proseccution.

Hence,
her evidence cannot be believed.

She also admits that she and accused are residing together now as per the settlement in M.C.No.
365/2019.
Therefore, this court was pleased to reject the prayer of the learned Sr.APP to summon other chargesheeted witnesses.

Even, if the summons was issued to other chargesheeted witnesses,
no purpose would be served as the material witness has given go- bye to her own statement and also the valuable time of the court would be saved.
As such other charge sheeted witnesses were dropped and prosecution evidence was taken as closed.
In view of the material witness, turning hostile the prosecution has failed to bring home the guilt of the accused beyond reasonable doubt.
Accordingly, I answer Point No.1 in the Negative.
